name: Emergency
overview: The Scriptures reveal that in times of emergency, God calls His people to immediate and decisive action, as seen when He instructs Moses to lead Israel forward despite seemingly impossible circumstances (Exodus 14:15). The situation with Israel in Joshua 7 further illustrates that emergencies often arise from sin and disobedience, which hinder God's presence and protection. Only through repentance, sanctification, and removing what is accursed can the people stand firm against their enemies and experience God's deliverance (Joshua 7:10-13).
